title: worker.heartbeat
description: Emitted when a worker advances its last_heartbeat_at. v0.9.2: emitted by trg_worker_heartbeat_event_emit. I16 strict monotonic enforcement.

last_heartbeat_at.description: New heartbeat timestamp (must be strictly greater than the prior value; enforced by trg_worker_heartbeat_renew).

current_attempt_id.description: The worker's active attempt, if any. Null when worker is idle.
